title: Veilleur - Location, Weakness & How to Beat
description: Veilleur in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33 - location, elemental weakness and how to beat it.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Two elements land and Dark is resisted, so Sciel's Dark kit is the wrong pick.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toLight, Lightning
ResistsDark
AbsorbsNone
ImmuneNone

Bring Light, Lightning damage. Dark is resisted, so those turns are wasted.

sections.title: How to Beat the Veilleur
sections.content:
Exploit the weakness

Light, Lightning is the element that lands. Elemental weaknesses in Expedition 33 are a 50% damage swing in both directions, so matching correctly is usually worth more than a tier of weapon upgrade.

What not to bring

  • It resists Dark, so that damage is halved.
